label: Mining overlay
blurb: What a scanned rock is, drawn under the scanner's signal. Off by default: while off, none of it runs.

fields.label: Mining overlay
fields.help: Reads the mining scanner's signal - the number above the compass - and draws what it is just under it: the rock and how many, from IRIS's table of signals (your copy: mining.txt in the data folder). A click-through window over the game, which needs borderless windowed. 'off' runs none of it: nothing read, nothing captured for it, no window.

fields.label: Mining overlay key
fields.help: With the overlay on: each press pauses it or carries on, and says 'mining off' or 'mining on'. While paused nothing is read or drawn. A single character, a name like f8, or a joystick button like joy0.b12. 'off' means no key: it runs all the time.

fields.label: Mining label size
fields.help: The label's letters, as a share of the signal's own digit height. IRIS's default is 150.
